work.note: The house was disconnected and the antenna lost its lattice. Restore continuous walls, a crossbar and a smooth connecting cable. Accepted exact-SVG visual exception after native-size review.

The surround had become a single arch and the fire a droplet. Restore a rectangular mantel surround, inset arched opening, and asymmetric flame. Accepted exact-SVG visual exception after native-size review.
The squat bowl read as a goblet and only one dense burst survived. Lengthen the flute and restore two airy firework bursts. Accepted exact-SVG visual exception after native-size review.
The divider was flattened into a horizontal bar. Restore the flowing S with balanced curved lobes. Strict model and build gate pass with zero warnings.

The frame lost its far support, the roof leaned, and the ladder was cramped. Restore symmetric roof, three rungs, far support and two hanging rings. Accepted exact-SVG visual exception after native-size review.
The eyes were tiny V marks and the mouth was a clogged blob. Widen the eyelids and draw an open double-lobed kiss. Accepted exact-SVG visual exception after native-size review.
The gear had uneven valleys and a stray center dot absent from the original. Make six balanced teeth and remove that dot. Accepted exact-SVG visual exception after native-size review.
The handle met the lens at an awkward angle and was too short. Use a smaller circular lens and a longer radially aligned handle. Strict model and build gate pass with zero warnings.

The center device became square, its cable disappeared, and side connections were truncated. Restore a tall center device and three descending cables. Accepted exact-SVG visual exception after native-size review.
The cob was blank and the husks heavy and misshapen. Restore an upright cob, two sweeping husks and a sparse kernel pattern. Accepted exact-SVG visual exception after native-size review.

The face was overly blocky and added unexplained detached marks. Restore the smooth head profile, nose, jaw and neck; retain two short cough rays to clarify the concept. Accepted exact-SVG visual exception after native-size review.
The moon lost one crater and another became a dot. Restore three open craters and a smooth horizon that occludes the lower moon. Accepted exact-SVG visual exception after native-size review.

The whipped topping read as a flame and the straw as a V. Restore a rounded swirl, right-angle straw bend and rounded cup with a wavy liquid line. Accepted exact-SVG visual exception after native-size review.
The blades became two plain crossing sticks and finger holes were too small. Restore broad cutting blades and larger circular handles. Accepted exact-SVG visual exception after native-size review.
The crown merged into its base and lost the tall tapered stem. Restore the chess-piece proportions, separate collar, flared stem and broad foot. Strict model and build gate pass with zero warnings.

The frosting had sharp joins and crowded scallops. Restore a smooth cloudlike dome and three clear, unequal drips above a rounded wrapper. Accepted exact-SVG visual exception after native-size review.
The grip became a short polygon and the hook an upright J. Restore the long diagonal rounded grip, diagonal neck and curling dental tip. Accepted exact-SVG visual exception after native-size review.
The free stroke had abrupt bends and the nib was narrow. Restore a smooth sweeping stroke and broader pointed nib with a diagonal slit. Accepted exact-SVG visual exception after native-size review.

The dome was squat and straw blocky; the liquid mark disappeared. Restore a taller dome, a smoothly bent straw, rounded cup and liquid mark. Accepted exact-SVG visual exception after native-size review.

The lower branches hit the sides of the nodes and the vertical trunk was too short. Restore a balanced three-node Y with radial joins and equal circles. Strict model and build gate pass with zero warnings.
